title: Fractions and equality in rationalized abelian groups
statement: Let $M$ be an abelian group and write $j:M\to M\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\mathbf Q$, $j(m)=m\otimes1$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Every $v\in M\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\mathbf Q$ has $nv=j(m)$ for some integer $n>0$ and some $m\in M$. For $a,b\in M$, one has $j(a)=j(b)$ if and only if $ca=cb$ for some integer $c>0$. No torsion-free hypothesis on $M$ is required.
